svg.title: Four-gated palace of the peaceful and wrathful mandala
svg.desc: A drawn study of the supplied painting: coloured curling fire, a vajra enclosure, blue water and wind bands with eight schematic charnel-ground landscapes, lotus enclosure, four-coloured palace, nested lotus seats and central sanctuary. All four gates repeat the same inward-facing deer and eight-spoked Dharma wheel. Matching parasols flank the upper and lower gates; matching victory banners flank the side gates, following the painting. The landscapes are not identifications of a lineage-specific named set.
